name: close_gripper
description: Propose a close command while holding the measured current grip-site pose. Use when: current evidence supports closing the jaws; use move_pose for a pose change. Effect: submits one observation-bound gripper-only action v3 proposal to the Supervisor and ends this turn. Returns: submitted status and close_gripper action immediately; the later receipt and fresh observation show measured motion and opening. Does not: move the pose target, establish contact, identify an object or prove retention; nominal aperture is not calibrated contact evidence. On error: wait for a pending action to finish and use fresh evidence before another mutation.
